Schedule and data details

Schedule for HBO Max, Paramount+, ESPN Unlimited, Apple TV, USA Network, Prime Video, Netflix and Disney+. Times and broadcast listings are shown below.

Schedule and broadcaster listings updated Sat Oct 10, 9:22 PM ET. Rebuilt early morning, midday and evening. Times shown in Eastern.

A colored broadcaster pill means a selected service carries that channel. Grey means it is outside your lineup. A dashed pill marked usually means established league coverage; the match listing remains unconfirmed. Package tiers and assignments can vary, so check the broadcaster's app before kickoff.

Team form squares show wins in green, draws in grey and losses in red. The two bars beneath a featured card are the teams' colors. For filters, saved preferences and match details, see the user guide.

Fixtures, scores, standings, most images and most broadcast listings come from ESPN. Some league emblems use compact artwork from the organizers' official websites; see artwork sources. Where ESPN has no listing, public broadcaster schedules are checked. Details links show the source or explain why coverage remains unconfirmed. While relevant matches are on, the browser checks scores about once a minute. US coverage mappings and their sources are maintained in rights.toml. Source code and development guide.

Each morning, gpt-6.1-sol, an OpenAI AI model, is asked to rate the matches the page shows, from today through the third day after it, for popularity (25%), expected gameplay (35%) and competitive impact (40%), from ESPN's table, form and stage and without seeing the Outlook score. Later rebuilds fill missing or newly listed ratings while keeping the day's accepted ratings. Its ratings are editorial judgments, not predicted results, and the page shows no AI-written text.

The page's own Outlook score rates every match from fixture and broadcast data, by the same arithmetic for each: the occasion's stature from the competition and any marquee clubs or nations (40%), how evenly matched the betting market sees the teams (25%), what the table or the knockout round puts at stake (15%), whether a broadcast network or a cable channel carries it (10%) and how many goals the market expects (10%). Betting-market inputs come from the odds in ESPN's feed; the page shows no prices. A match's interest is 70% the AI rating and 30% the Outlook score (the Outlook score alone for a match without an AI rating), and its pick score is 95% interest and 5% league priority, adjustable in Lineup. Each match shows its pick score as one to five golden dots: two from 35, three from 45, four from 55 and five from 68 out of 100. Pick scores rank interest; they do not predict results. See how recommendations work for the formula and default league order.

Live now shows the highest-scoring available match ESPN confirms is in progress. Otherwise, Next up counts down to the earliest confirmed kickoff within the displayed days. Top three selects up to three other matches on your services and competitions by score, then shows them in kickoff order. When any remaining candidate has an AI rating, only rated candidates compete for those places.

The schedule covers today and the three days after it. Each day starts at 4 am in your time zone so late matches stay with their evening. Open Schedule and data details above for the last build time, live-score checks and coverage summary.
